STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_171252.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_171252.v · Open raw
module origen_171252(
    input V_ex,
    input eip_change,
    input AF_needed,
    input DF_needed,
    input CF_needed,
    input v_wb_ld_flag_AF,
    input v_wb_ld_flag_DF,
    input v_wb_ld_flag_CF,
    input wb_mem_stall,
    input ld_reg1,
    input ld_reg2,
    input ld_reg3,
    input ld_flag_ZF,
    input ld_seg,
    input ld_mm,
    input ld_mem,
    output v_ro_ld_reg1,
    output v_ro_ld_reg2,
    output v_ro_ld_reg3,
    output v_ro_ld_flag_ZF,
    output v_ro_ld_seg,
    output v_ro_ld_mm,
    output v_ro_ld_mem,
    output dep_stall,
    output br_stall,
    output V_wb,
    output ld_wb
);

    // Generate read-only load signals
    assign v_ro_ld_reg1 = V_ex & ld_reg1;
    assign v_ro_ld_reg2 = V_ex & ld_reg2;
    assign v_ro_ld_reg3 = V_ex & ld_reg3;
    assign v_ro_ld_flag_ZF = V_ex & ld_flag_ZF;
    assign v_ro_ld_seg = V_ex & ld_seg;
    assign v_ro_ld_mm = V_ex & ld_mm;
    assign v_ro_ld_mem = V_ex & ld_mem;

    // Detect dependency stalls
    assign dep_stall = (AF_needed & v_wb_ld_flag_AF) |
                       (DF_needed & v_wb_ld_flag_DF) |
                       (CF_needed & v_wb_ld_flag_CF);

    // Detect branch stalls
    assign br_stall = V_ex & eip_change;

    // Generate write-back validity signal
    assign V_wb = V_ex & !dep_stall;

    // Generate load during write-back stage
    assign ld_wb = V_wb & !wb_mem_stall;

endmodule
